done_when: Client sign-off finishes: a later attempt reviews only files changed since the last sign-off review plus its earlier findings, and after round 2 only P0 findings block.
why: Client sign-off never finishes: every attempt re-reviews all product files with no memory of earlier findings and no round limit, so a client saw 23, 15, 12, 33, 3, 2 and 3 new findings over seven attempts.
